# NexGen Business Advisors Ltd

> Business advisory, audit, tax and accounting firm in Lagos, Nigeria. Helps diaspora investors, foreign companies, SMEs and entrepreneurs set up, stay compliant and become investment-ready in Nigeria.

Website: https://www.nextgenadvisorsltd.com
Location: Banana Island, Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria
Phone: +234 803 734 5051
Email: info@nextgenadvisors.com
Book a consultation: https://calendly.com/nextgenadvisorsltd-info/30min

## What the firm does

- Business setup and market entry: CAC company and branch registration, market research and feasibility, licensing and regulatory guidance.
- Tax advisory and compliance: tax planning, TIN registration, FIRS and State tax filings, VAT, WHT and PAYE compliance monitoring.
- Accounting, bookkeeping and financial structuring: accounting systems, bookkeeping, financial reporting, cash flow management, internal controls, stock-taking and valuation.
- Loan and investment facilitation: bank-ready business proposals, feasibility studies, cash flow projections, support with institutional financing.
- Banking and institutional liaison: corporate banking setup and liaison with regulators and institutional partners.
- Ongoing advisory and retainer services: governance, monthly compliance and financial health reviews, long-term planning.
- Audit, taxation and statutory compliance (delivered through affiliate firm Joy Ozua & Co., Chartered Accountants): statutory audit, IFRS financial reporting, CAC corporate filings.
- Financial strategy and business transformation: financial cleanup, IFRS restatements, CFO advisory, investment readiness.

## Who it serves

SMEs and entrepreneurs, Nigerians in the diaspora investing at home, foreign companies entering Nigeria, professional services firms, trade and bilateral organisations, and growing corporates.

## Leadership

- Joy Ozua, Managing Director and Lead Consultant. Licensed member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria (ICAN) with over 15 years in audit, taxation, governance and strategic advisory. Former CFO and Acting Director General of the Nigerian-German Chamber of Commerce. Previously with Parker Randall Offor and Moore Bishop & Rooks.
- Desmond Abollo, Chartered Accountant and Virtual CFO. Over 20 years of experience, Certified Management Consultant, founder of CloudERP Accounting & Business Solutions.
